saw_lines: Nobody switches toothbrushes often. People replace one when it frays, and keep it until a dentist gives them a reason.
So the sale is won or lost in line one, where a shopper decides if a brush is worth a look.
Your site shows a 4.9 rating, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number. Put the 4.9 rating on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 13 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows a 4.9 rating, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing to check. Put the 4.9 rating on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

Your site offers Subscribe and Save, yet 0 of 30 ads mention any offer or discount. Buyers who would reorder never see the saving. Put the subscription saving in line one of three new ads and on the creative.

18 of 30 ads open on the same 2 minute brushing line, so most of your reach hears one pitch. Write two new angles from your own product, like the built-in scanner tracking your mouth, and test each against that opener.

Your site sells a subscription, yet 0 of 30 ads mention one, so repeat buyers see no reason to reorder. Run two retention ads for past customers with the subscription saving as the headline and 20 seconds as proof.

ads_1: Scanner and 20 second angles, each carrying the 4.9 rating and subscription saving
